plain_text:
The Library finds a Friend in
Peter Durkin.
semantic_text: The Library finds a Friend in Peter Durkin.

plain_text:
Originally from New Hampshire, Peter Durkin
grew up visiting Washington, D.C., with his
family. He's worked in Congress and in
political campaigns and now directs product
management at a D.C.-based startup. Today,
he calls Washington home.
semantic_text: Originally from New Hampshire, Peter Durkin grew up visiting Washington, D.C., with his family. He's worked in Congress and in political campaigns and now directs product management at a D.C.-based startup. Today, he calls Washington home.

plain_text:
Durkin frequents the Library and sometimes
even works in its inspiring Main Reading
Room in the iconic Thomas Jefferson
Building. He encourages everyone he meets
to spend time in the Library, a beautiful
place that is open and accessible to all.
semantic_text: Durkin frequents the Library and sometimes even works in its inspiring Main Reading Room in the iconic Thomas Jefferson Building. He encourages everyone he meets to spend time in the Library, a beautiful place that is open and accessible to all.

plain_text:
He joined the new Friends of the Library
group after learning about it on the Library's
website at loc.gov/donate. He found the idea
"compelling, that any amount of support
can help this amazing institution."
semantic_text: He joined the new Friends of the Library group after learning about it on the Library's website at loc.gov/donate. He found the idea "compelling, that any amount of support can help this amazing institution."

plain_text:
Support from Friends, he learned, goes to
free public programming, new collections
and innovative ideas like a new online game
to encourage civic engagement. Durkin's
favorite part of being a Library Friend is the
special events.
semantic_text: Support from Friends, he learned, goes to free public programming, new collections and innovative ideas like a new online game to encourage civic engagement. Durkin's favorite part of being a Library Friend is the special events.

plain_text:
"The events are always informative, unique
and remind us of the incredible work being
done that benefits us all," he said.
semantic_text: "The events are always informative, unique and remind us of the incredible work being done that benefits us all," he said.

plain_text:
Last year, he enjoyed attending the Library's
National Book Festival and a book talk
featuring a Library publication,
“American
Feast: Cookbooks and Cocktails from the
Library of Congress.
”
semantic_text: Last year, he enjoyed attending the Library's National Book Festival and a book talk featuring a Library publication, “American Feast: Cookbooks and Cocktails from the Library of Congress. ”

plain_text:
When asked why he supports the Library of
Congress, Durkin said,
“The Library is a one-
of-a-kind institution. Its positive influence
touches the entire country. All Americans
need to know that this is a place they're
welcome to come and learn and take part in
a major piece of history.
”
